fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM181,240. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0057850/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: At least 2.5 CGPA at STPM level in Science stream (for non-Science-stream STPM, 2.5 CGPA and a Credit in TWO (2) Science subjects at SPM level); A Full Pass in STPM Pengajian Am (General Studies) and TWO (2) other subjects, plus a Partial Pass in TWO (2) other subjects; TWO (2) Full Passes at A-level; An MSU Diploma in Traditional Chinese Medicine (also with at least 2.5 CGPA); Other equivalent qualifications in a related field and recognized by MSU Senate.
